recommendation: Use standard PyMuPDF save(garbage=4,deflate=True,no_new_id=True) for the final assembled book, then run the final audit and visual review against its new hash.

verified_result.scope: All-page exact extracted glyph/font/image records, exact vector operations, link semantics/rectangles and embedded actions, metadata, labels, outlines, named destinations and exact attachment bytes. PDF object identities excluded from semantic link/vector comparisons.

unverified_variants: Objectstream variants were measured only; the full semantic/geometry equivalence verification applies to garbage4 without objectstreams.
font_handling: No font substitution, subsetting or custom font stream rewriting.
